in_arabic.name: Amlaas
in_arabic.long_meaning: Amlaas هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'alam', meaning 'to feed'. Amlaas signifies nourishment, sustenance, and provision. In Islamic context, it symbolizes the sustenance provided by Allah (swt) and the nurturing role of parents and caregivers.
